answer: Reputation here is age you cannot buy. Seniority accrues only by staying active across epochs, and that clock ticks one second per second: no stake, no rig, no minted key can fast-forward it. Rewards scale with the square root of seniority, so one falcon watching two years outweighs a thousand fledglings. A karst cavern is carved by centuries of slow seepage; a farm cannot carve trust by printing aliases overnight. Each jetty plank extends the bridge, plank by plank, never poured at once. The sybil operator bought speed, not standing; his clones are newborns, and newborns draw no pay.
